title: When and How Order-Flow Interventions Work After Dealers Adapt
abstract: arXiv:2610.18158v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Learning dealer agents can settle on persistently wide quotes, raising what customers pay to trade. A venue can route more orders to tighter quotes, but a wide quote may reflect real risk, and once dealers adapt, an end-to-end comparison cannot show why a rule works: because it intervenes more, picks better moments, is announced in advance, or rewards the right quote. We propose SOFA (State-aligned Order-Flow Allocation), a public order-flow contract with three parts: a State Scorer ranks market states from lagged public data, a Commitment Scheduler announces a budgeted intervention strength before dealers quote, and a Quote-to-Flow Allocator shifts a bounded share of fixed customer demand toward tighter quotes. Our paired re-adaptation protocol gives competing rules the same intervention strengths, only re-timed, lets dealers re-adapt to each rule from a shared checkpoint, and breaks one link at a time. translated_title: 做市商适应之后，订单流干预何时以及如何起作用
translated_abstract: 学习型做市商智能体可能会持续维持较宽的报价，从而抬高客户的交易成本。交易平台可以将更多订单路由至更窄（更紧）的报价，但宽幅报价可能反映的是真实风险，而且一旦做市商适应了规则，端到端的对比就无法说明一项规则为何有效：是因为它干预得更多、选择了更好的时机、提前进行了公告，还是奖励了正确的报价。我们提出SOFA（状态对齐的订单流分配），这是一个由三部分构成的公开订单流合约：状态评分器基于滞后的公开数据对市场状态进行排序；承诺调度器在做市商报价之前宣布预算化的干预强度；报价-流量分配器将固定客户需求中有界的一部分份额转向更窄的报价。我们的成对再适应协议为相互竞争的规则提供相同的干预强度（仅重新安排时机），让做市商从共享的检查点出发对每条规则重新适应，并每次只打破一个因果环节。在20个独立训练的……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出SOFA公开订单流合约（状态评分器、承诺调度器、报价-流量分配器三部分），并配合成对再适应协议，使研究者能在做市商重新适应后逐步拆解订单流干预究竟因何种机制而起作用。
en_tdlr: Proposes SOFA, a public order-flow contract combining a State Scorer, Commitment Scheduler, and Quote-to-Flow Allocator, together with a paired re-adaptation protocol that isolates why order-flow interventions still work after dealer agents re-adapt.
